field_updates.detail: "Typical reverse recovery time IF = 0.5 A, IR = 1.0 A, Irr = 0.25 A trr 1.8 us" (S1A-S1M, typical) Method: Charge-control storage-time estimate used by the SPICE lumped-charge diode: ts = TT*ln(1+IF/IR). Treating the whole quoted trr as storage time gives TT = trr/ln(1+IF/IR). Ignores the recovery tail to the quoted Irr, junction capacitance and RS, so it over-estimates TT. TT = 1.8 us/ln(1.5) = 4.44 us (approximate, upper-leaning).
